items.reason: Topic#url delegates to Topic.url, which explicitly prefixes Discourse.base_url (app/models/topic.rb:703–710). Therefore unsubscribe_url appends /unsubscribe to an absolute URL (app/models/topic.rb:719–720), and the mailer passes that absolute URL into the email (app/mailers/user_notifications.rb:295); the claimed relative URL does not exist.
